answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive guide to the **best websites for free 3D game assets** in 2025:

---

## 🎮 Top Sites for Free 3D Game Assets

---

### 1. 🟠 [Kenney.nl](https://kenney.nl)
Kenney's comprehensive asset collection is totally free! Despite the non-existent price tag, these assets are pretty high quality. There are 2D assets, 3D assets, UI assets, and even a few simple audio assets. All of the assets come with a commercial-use licence and are totally free to use.

---

### 2. 🟣 [Itch.io](https://itch.io/game-assets/free/tag-3d)
Itch.io is a community-driven platform where indie developers share free and premium game assets. The community constantly adds new assets, ensuring diverse styles for every type of project. You'll find assets like **KayKit - Character Pack: Adventurers**, **Stylized Nature MegaKit**, **KayKit - Dungeon Pack Remastered**, and more.

---

### 3. 🔵 [Unity Asset Store](https://assetstore.unity.com)
The Unity Asset Store provides an extensive collection of free, high-quality game assets designed specifically for Unity projects. 3D is Unity's bread and butter with 41k+ assets available. You'll find plenty of low poly meshes as well as a few pre-made animations.

---

### 4. 🟡 [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org)
OpenGameArt has a great list of game models, foliage, backgrounds, UI, tilesets, and other game artists' and designers' resources. This site is great for those seeking unique art styles contributed by indie artists worldwide.

---

### 5. 🟢 [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com)
Sketchfab's site UI is fantastic. It's designed to get you 3D game assets as quickly as possible. Split up into various categories like cars, cartoons, tilesets, and more, Sketchfab directs you to what you need. You can also manually search for specific models you have in mind.

---

### 6. 🔴 [ArtStation Marketplace](https://www.artstation.com/marketplace/game-dev/assets/3d)
There are a ton of high-quality free game assets in all kinds of styles. Not just limited to meshes and artwork, the assets also include custom-built textures and elements like clothing and hair.

---

### 7. 🟤 [BlenderKit](https://www.blenderkit.com)
The BlenderKit marketplace site offers free and paid assets, brushes for artists, and other materials. BlenderKit downloads these various models and materials directly into the Blender engine, making the transition and downloading process effortless.

---

### 8. ⚪ [Free3D](https://free3d.com)
Free3D hosts 15,000+ 3D models in various formats for Blender, OBJ, 3DS, C4D, MAX, and Maya, which you can download absolutely for free. For game development, Free3D also hosts several low-poly models made specifically for real-time usage.

---

### 9. 🔷 [Fab.com](https://fab.com)
Fab is a growing platform featuring free and premium 3D models, textures, and materials — perfect for developers focused on realistic 3D environments.

---

### 10. 🟥 [CGTrader](https://cgtrader.com)
CGTrader is one of the best free 3D model websites for game developers, offering a wide range of downloadable game-ready models in various styles.

---

## 💡 Pro Tips
- Many free assets are available for commercial use, but **always check the license terms** before including them in your game.
- Consider using a **complete asset pack** to develop your game if possible. Asset packs often include everything you need to create a game world and are a fantastic way to keep your game art looking consistent.
- Finding high-quality free game assets can **save time, cut costs, and speed up production** — especially for indie developers.
